thesis.core: Hengli shipbuilding continues to support a genuine operating and earnings step change, but the equity rerated further into 2026-09-18 while no new disclosure upgraded normalized earnings or free-cash-flow economics.
thesis.variant_wedge: The operating inflection is real; the rejection is valuation and financed-growth risk. The 2026-09-16 shareholder-meeting actions and 2026-09-19 H1 briefing notice do not alter the earnings/cash framework, while the 9/18 close at RMB208 materially worsens prospective return.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Retain 2026E normalized EPS bear/base/bull of RMB5.50/RMB7.50/RMB9.00; no post-H1 primary evidence warrants an earnings upgrade.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: No material post-H1 operating disclosure changes the prior normalized earnings range.

catalysts: High-value ship orders convert into deliveries at or above H1 margins.
New yard and engine capacity reaches high utilization without material cost overruns.
Normalized earnings or ROIC upgrades enough to offset the substantially higher market price.
Financing flexibility improves without debt, finance expense and capex outrunning sustainable free cash generation.
kill_thesis: Newbuild pricing or orders roll over before expanded capacity matures.
Delivery delays, cancellations, steel/FX pressure or mix deterioration compress normalized margin.
Debt, finance expense and capex continue to grow faster than sustainable free cash generation.
